text: Dissimilar metals in contact in an electrolyte (seawater, condensate on surfaces) shall not be used unless the galvanic potential difference is below 0.15 V, or the anodic part is more than 10 times the area of the cathodic part, or the contact is isolated. Isolation shall be achieved with isolating flanges (gaskets, sleeves and washers of PTFE / G10), non-conductive spools of GRP at least 5 diameters long, or lined pipe.
